article.title: BRICS Summit 2026: Transforming “Pyramid of privilege” into ” platform of partnership”
article.summary: After successfully hosting the G20 Summit in 2023, Bharat successfully organised 18th BRICS Summit 2026 at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi from September 12-13. On the first day, leaders of BRICS countries participated in the event. The prominent names include Chinese President Xi Jinping, Russian President Vladimir Putin, South African President Cyril Ramaphosa, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, Malaysian Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim, and among others participated in this summit. “It is now time for us to translate our unity and consensus in BRICS into concrete outcomes on the global stage. While strengthening BRICS, we must also chart the direction of global reform. The current structure of Global Governance appears like a pyramid. The Global South is today in the front row of global crises, but in the back row of decision-making. We have to transform this “pyramid of privilege” into a “platform of partnership”, where every country has a voice, every member has a stake,...

article.summary:

article.title: BRICS 18th Summit, 2026 – Bharat ascending with a shared vision into a win-win collaboration of the Global South
article.summary: There are summits that produce communiqués, and there are summits that produce a shift; September 12-13, 2026, the events at Bharat Mandapam were placed in the second category. On the first day, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said the 45-page, 140 point New Delhi Declaration had been agreed to. People in his close circle seemed to know immediately what that meant. It did not feel like the usual rhythm of long sessions. In those meetings, the wording gets cut and reshaped until the final text only just meets the goal. Then the paper gets handed over at the end of the night. This was a demonstration of statecraft at the highest level with utmost efficacy, and the state that demonstrated it was Bharat. For those of us who have long argued that India’s civilisational depth entitles it to a shaping role in world affairs, not a supplicant’s seat at somebody else’s table, the BRICS, New Delhi Summit was vindication written in real time. article.title: BRICS after New Delhi declaration: A strategic makeover
article.summary: The 18th BRICS Summit-New Delhi Declaration, adopted unanimously on September 12, is a masterstroke of Indian diplomacy under PM Modi’s leadership. Under India’s chairpersonship, PM Modi set the theme “Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Stability” for the BRICS Summit 2026 held in New Delhi. The declaration was unanimous, though it was tough to convince Iran and the UAE to agree, and it was another major win for Indian diplomacy. More importantly, the New Delhi 2026 Declaration marks a deliberate ‘strategic makeover’ for BRICS, shifting it from a purely economic, trade-oriented forum. BRIC started as an informal group of Brazil, Russia, India and China in 2006 and had its first summit in Russia in 2009, after the 2008 global financial crisis. South Africa joined in 2010, and the grouping became BRICS. article.title: BRICS Summit a success, we forged consensus in midst of a polarised world: Jaishankar
article.summary: New Delhi, Sep 14:The BRICS Summit took place in the backdrop of a “very polarised world” and “we forged a consensus” in the midst of it, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar said on Monday, as he described the mega event hosted under India's chairship a success.Interacting with mediapersons here, he also spoke about what was definitely the “toughest issue of the day”, the West Asia conflict, saying, “We were able to get out a statement to which everybody agreed.”The BRICS members adopted a joint New Delhi Declaration on Saturday after overcoming sharp divisions between the UAE and Iran regarding the West Asia conflict while notably omitting direct mention of the US for its attacks on Iran.The negotiations on the text of the declaration went down to the wire as both Iran and the UAE hardened their positions initially.Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced the adoption of the declaration at the end of the opening day's deliberations in the presence of Chinese President Xi Jinping, ...
